standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a morphism of algebraic stacks being locally of finite type through smooth covers by schemes, and the stability of surjective smooth morphisms under composition and base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on morphisms of finite type, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the proof to read the property off the level of the covering schemes.

standard_prerequisites.name: The corresponding permanence statement for morphisms of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 3630-3631 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the conclusion for the middle morphism of schemes, which is what the definition requires.

core_obligations: Choose a compatible diagram of covers: the proof finds schemes mapping smoothly and surjectively onto the three stacks so that the middle map is a smooth cover of the fibre product of the middle stack with the right hand scheme and the left hand map is a smooth cover of the corresponding fibre product (proof lines 3616-3626)

Identify a composite: it observes that the left hand map is also a smooth cover of the fibre product of the left stack with the middle scheme, being the composite of a smooth surjection with a base change of one (proof lines 3627-3629)

Conclude: the composite of the two maps of schemes is locally of finite type by hypothesis, hence so is the middle one by the corresponding statement for schemes, which by definition means that the middle morphism of stacks is locally of finite type (proof lines 3629-3633)
proof_roadmap: 取概型 U → V → W 与满光滑态射 W → Z、V → Y ×_Z W、U → X ×_Y V，则 U → X ×_Z V 也满光滑（满光滑与基变换的复合）。
由定义 U → W 局部有限型，故由概型层面的 permanence（跨章引理）U → V 也局部有限型，再按定义得 X → Y 局部有限型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a composite of morphisms of algebraic stacks the first factor is locally of finite type whenever the composite is (author lemma at source lines 3607-3612, label lemma-finite-type-permanence). The proof (source lines 3615-3633) builds a compatible diagram of smooth scheme covers, notes that the left hand map is a smooth cover of a suitable fibre product, and applies the corresponding permanence statement for morphisms of schemes to the composite of the covering maps (proof lines 3616-3633). The construction of the compatible covers is the content. H2.
